title: Refill Contact Settings by Resupply Schedule (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
Four settings of the PAP Supply Replenishment Program govern refill contact on each resupply schedule: the most calendar days a refill confirmation may precede the ship date it supports, whether shipments may go out without a fresh refill confirmation for each cycle, whether the patient must confirm that the supply on hand is nearly exhausted before each shipment, and the channels through which a refill confirmation is accepted.

| Schedule | Refill lead days (most calendar days a confirmation may precede the ship date) | Automatic shipment allowed | On-hand check required before each shipment | Channels accepted for a refill confirmation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicare Part B Resupply Schedule | 14 | no | yes | phone call, text message, patient portal |
| Medicare Advantage Resupply Schedule | 14 | no | yes | phone call, text message, patient portal |
| Medicaid Resupply Schedule | 14 | no | yes | phone call only |
| Commercial HMO Resupply Schedule | 21 | yes | no | phone call, text message, patient portal, email |
| Commercial PPO Resupply Schedule | 21 | yes | no | phone call, text message, patient portal, email |
| Self-Pay Supply Subscription | 30 | yes | no | text message, patient portal, email |

## Points of judgement

- **Automatic shipment.** Shipments without a fresh refill confirmation for each cycle are allowed on the Commercial HMO, Commercial PPO and Self-Pay schedules, and not on the Medicare Part B, Medicare Advantage or Medicaid schedules.
- **On-hand check.** The three schedules that do not allow automatic shipment are exactly the three that require the on-hand check.
- **Channels.** Email is accepted only on the two commercial schedules and the Self-Pay Supply Subscription; a phone call is accepted on every schedule except the Self-Pay Supply Subscription; the Medicaid Resupply Schedule accepts a phone call and nothing else.
- **Lead days.** 14 calendar days on the Medicare and Medicaid schedules, 21 on the commercial schedules, 30 on the Self-Pay Supply Subscription.
